model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with various criteria. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Criterion", displaying seven discrete items from top to bottom. The horizontal axis represents the value, labeled "Number of Participants", employing a linear scale with a data range from 0 to 6 and numeric tick labels provided at regular intervals of 2, delineated by vertical gridlines. The chart features horizontal single bars that are sorted in descending order of length from top to bottom, with each bar featuring a numeric annotation placed immediately to its right to indicate the exact value. The bars follow a color gradient transitioning from dark purple at the top to yellow-green at the bottom. The longest bar at the top corresponds to "Relevant FCs", rendered in dark purple with an annotated value of 6. This is followed by "FC Summary" in dark blue with a value of 5. The next two categories, "Relevance Explanation" (teal) and "Clarity and Simplicity" (medium green), are equal in length, each with an annotated value of 3. Below them is "Overall Summary", colored in emerald green, with a value of 2. The two shortest bars at the bottom correspond to "Filters" in light green and "Veracity Explanation" in yellow-green, both having identical annotated values of 1.
